g.text: Self-trade prevention stays in one lane:
the BBO core marks h, the lane writes the tombstone
account a owns both the taker
the head is a's own order h
BBO core's own array · level a1
STP: mark h closed in the core's own array,
an earlier op of the same packet is in the push's
dependency list with its pre-assigned handle (01 §14.2),
so STP sees it as if it rested at its own priority
an account lives in one lane,
so the taker and h meet here
cancel newest: outs the taker, leaves h · cancel both: does both
